inverse.from: 拿掉弯路是一次计算：每一种弯路，核都有一条计算规则，把它换成算下来的样子。后两段证同样的两句，接出算下来的那一个。
inverse.to: Taking a detour out is a computation: for each kind of detour the kernel has a computation rule that puts what it works out to in its place. The last two tasks prove the same two sentences, wired as what they work out to.

inverse.from: 同一句话可以有好几个证明项，有的绕了远路：刚造出一样东西，马上又用掉。⟨p, q⟩.1 先拼后拆，算下来就是 p；框造出的函数马上用在 p 上，算下来是框里的证明，其中的 h 都换成 p。前两段先接出两条这样的弯路。
inverse.to: One sentence can have several terms, and some go the long way round: something made and at once used up. ⟨p, q⟩.1 joins and splits, and works out to p; a function from a box used on p at once works out to the proof inside, with every h replaced by p. The first two tasks wire two such detours.

inverse.from: 算掉弯路
inverse.to: Computing detours away

inverse.from: 括号里的先算：p r 是一次套用，q 再用在它上面。
inverse.to: What is in brackets comes first: p r is one Apply, and q is used on that.

inverse.from: 证明项须为 q (p r)。
inverse.to: Its proof term must be q (p r).

inverse.from: 括号
inverse.to: Brackets

inverse.from: p q r 是 (p q) r：先把 p 用在 q 上，得到的再用在 r 上。
inverse.to: p q r is (p q) r: first p used on q, then what that gives used on r.

inverse.from: 证明项须为 p q r。
inverse.to: Its proof term must be p q r.

inverse.from: 两次应用
inverse.to: Two applications

inverse.from: 每条已知的名字就是它的证明项。A → B 的证明可以看成一个函数：给它 A 的证明，它还你 B 的证明。所以套用就是函数应用，写作 p q。一句话是一个类型，它的证明是这个类型的程序：这叫。
inverse.to: The name of each given is its proof term. A proof of A → B can be seen as a function: give it a proof of A and it gives back a proof of B. So Apply is function application, written p q. A sentence is a type, and its proof a program of that type: this is the .

inverse.from: 到这里为止，证明板只显示一句话证出了没有。这一章看证明本身：它可以写成一个式子，叫<wiki-ref to="proof-term"></wiki-ref>，写法照<wiki-ref to="lean"></wiki-ref>。从这一关起，证明板上的元件都显示自己的证明项。
inverse.to: Until now the proof board has only shown whether a sentence is proved. This chapter looks at the proof itself: it can be written as an expression, a <wiki-ref to="proof-term"></wiki-ref>, written as in <wiki-ref to="lean"></wiki-ref>. From this level on, every part on the proof board shows its proof term.

inverse.from: 套用就是应用
inverse.to: Apply is application

inverse.from: fun a h 是实例框：a 是那样东西，h 是它满足的那句。
inverse.to: fun a h is the instance box: a is the thing, h the sentence it fits.

inverse.from: 证明项须为 p.elim (fun a h => ⟨a, h.1⟩)。
inverse.to: Its proof term must be p.elim (fun a h => ⟨a, h.1⟩).

inverse.from: 实例框
inverse.to: Instance box

inverse.from: 一对的左边是例子，右边是例子满足它的证明。
inverse.to: The pair’s left is the example, its right the proof that the example fits.

inverse.from: 证明项须为 ⟨i, p⟩。
inverse.to: Its proof term must be ⟨i, p⟩.

inverse.from: ∃ 是一对
inverse.to: ∃ is a pair

inverse.from: fun a 是任取框（a 是任取的那一样），fun h 是假设框。
inverse.to: fun a is the for-any box (a the thing taken), fun h the assumption box.

inverse.from: 证明项须为 fun a h => h。
inverse.to: Its proof term must be fun a h => h.

inverse.from: 任取框是 fun
inverse.to: The for-any box is fun

inverse.from: p i：把安交给 p，得到的是关于安的那句话。
inverse.to: p i: hand Ann to p, and out comes the sentence about Ann.

inverse.from: 证明项须为 p i q。
inverse.to: Its proof term must be p i q.

inverse.from: ∀ 是函数
inverse.to: ∀ is a function

inverse.from: → 就是不依赖参数的 ∀。
inverse.to: → is just a ∀ that does not depend on its argument.

inverse.from: 「∀x. …」的证明也是函数，只是参数不是证明，而是一样东西：给它 t，它还你关于 t 的那句话的证明。这叫，写作 p i。「∃x. …」的证明是一对：一样东西（见证）和它满足那句话的证明；用它时写 p.elim (fun a h => …)。
inverse.to: A proof of “∀x. …” is a function too, but its argument is a thing, not a proof: given t, it gives back a proof of the sentence about t. This is a , and is written p i. A proof of “∃x. …” is a pair: a thing (the witness) and a proof that it fits; using one is written p.elim (fun a h => …).

inverse.from: 最后一句要在三句话里找出矛盾。
inverse.to: The last row looks for a contradiction among three sentences.

inverse.from: 由等价和「进位是 1」得出两个输入都是 1，一个元件不够。
inverse.to: From the equivalence and “the carry is 1” to both inputs being 1: one part is not enough.

inverse.from: 选出每一句的 by。
inverse.to: Choose each row’s by.

inverse.from: 人写结构，证明助手补小步：真正的证明大多这样分工。
inverse.to: People write the structure and proof assistants fill in the small steps: most real proofs are shared out this way.

inverse.from: by 后面也可以是造好的证明助手：自建 auto、化简、证明重建器。它们只用规则，所以这一句照样由核证出。
inverse.to: by may also be followed by a proof assistant already built: your own auto, Simp, the reconstructor. They use only rules, so the row is still proved by the kernel.

inverse.from: by 后面是一个证明助手
inverse.to: A proof assistant after by

inverse.from: 这一关的化简会按加法的定义算。
inverse.to: This level’s Simp works by the definition of addition.

inverse.from: <level-ref to="peirce"></level-ref>：auto 证不出来的。
inverse.to: <level-ref to="peirce"></level-ref>: auto cannot prove it.

inverse.from: 用到的事实都写在 using 里，剩下的交给 auto。
inverse.to: Put the facts used after using, and leave the rest to auto.

inverse.from: 一句话若由你造的证明助手一步证完，脚本里就只写一行：show … by auto。
inverse.to: When a proof assistant you built proves a sentence outright, the script is a single row: show … by auto.

inverse.from: 一行就够
inverse.to: One row is enough

inverse.from: proof 到 qed 是一个假设框，assume 是框里的假设。
inverse.to: proof to qed is an assumption box, and assume is what it assumes.

inverse.from: 由「下雨」和「下雨 → 地湿」得出「地湿」，用的是哪一条规则？
inverse.to: From “it rains” and “it rains → the ground is wet” to “the ground is wet”: which rule is that?

inverse.from: 脚本和证明电路是同一个证明的两种写法。
inverse.to: A script and a proof circuit are two ways of writing one proof.

inverse.from: <wiki-ref to="provers"></wiki-ref>里的证明也可以写给人读，这叫<wiki-ref to="scripts"></wiki-ref>。这一章的脚本照 Isabelle 的 Isar 写法：have 证出路上的一句，show 证出要证的那句，by 后面写这一句用的规则或证明助手，using 后面写它用到的事实；proof … qed 是一个块。
inverse.to: Proofs in a <wiki-ref to="provers"></wiki-ref> can also be written for people to read: a <wiki-ref to="scripts"></wiki-ref>. This chapter’s scripts follow Isabelle’s Isar: have proves a sentence on the way, show the one wanted, by names the rule or proof assistant a row uses and using the facts it uses; proof … qed is a block.

inverse.from: 一句一个元件
inverse.to: A row is a part

inverse.from: 对 xs 归纳，每种情况化简。
inverse.to: Induction on xs, and Simp on each case.

inverse.from: 这一关的化简集合里有列表的定义和<level-ref to="in-revapp"></level-ref>证出的那条等式。
inverse.to: This level’s simp set holds the definitions of lists and the equation proved in <level-ref to="in-revapp"></level-ref>.

inverse.from: 倒两次，写成脚本
inverse.to: Reversed twice, as a script

inverse.from: 假设真有这样一只鸟。
inverse.to: Suppose there is such a bird.

inverse.from: 有了一句「存在」，obtain 把那一样东西拿出来，起个名字，后面的句子都能用它。
inverse.to: Given a “there is”, obtain takes that thing out and names it, and the rows after it can use it.

inverse.from: obtain 拆开 ∃
inverse.to: obtain takes ∃ apart

inverse.from: a 和 b 是同一种人，又一个说另一个是无赖：这个矛盾交给证明重建器。
inverse.to: a and b the same kind, and one calling the other a knave: hand that contradiction to the reconstructor.

inverse.from: 假设 c 是骑士，他的话就成立。
inverse.to: Suppose c is a knight: then what he says holds.

inverse.from: a 说：「b 是无赖。」c 说：「a 和 b 是同一种人。」写一段脚本，证明 c 是无赖。
inverse.to: a says: “b is a knave.” c says: “a and b are the same kind.” Write a script that proves c is a knave.

inverse.from: 把证明写给人看：假设了什么，推出什么，矛盾在哪里；每一步交给合适的证明助手。
inverse.to: Write the proof for people: what is supposed, what follows, where the contradiction lies; each step handed to the right proof assistant.

inverse.from: 骑士与无赖，写成脚本
inverse.to: Knights and knaves, as a script

inverse.from: 先把「下雨 ∧ 刮风」拆成两句。
inverse.to: First split “it rains ∧ it is windy” into two.

inverse.from: 这段脚本少了两句。补上它们。
inverse.to: This script is two rows short. Put them in.

inverse.from: show 用到的 h1 还没有。新加的一行排在选中的那一行后面；要排到它前面，先删掉它再重写。
inverse.to: The h1 that show uses is not there yet. A new row goes after the row selected; to put one in front, remove that row and write it again.

inverse.from: 这段脚本少了一句。补上它。
inverse.to: This script is a row short. Put it in.

inverse.from: 写脚本时，常常先写最后一句 show，再往前补它用到的事实，一句一句 have 出来。
inverse.to: A script is often written from its last show backwards: the facts it uses are filled in before it, one have at a time.

inverse.from: 补一句 have
inverse.to: A missing have

inverse.from: 块里先 fix 一样东西。
inverse.to: In the block, fix a thing first.

inverse.from: 写一段脚本，证出要证的那句。
inverse.to: Write a script that proves the sentence.

inverse.from: 要证「对所有 x」，块的第一句是 fix：任取一样东西，给它起个名字。
inverse.to: To prove “for all x”, the block starts with fix: take any thing and give it a name.

inverse.from: fix 是任取框
inverse.to: fix is the for-any box

inverse.from: 两个框，一个套在另一个里面。
inverse.to: Two boxes, one inside the other.

inverse.from: 在证明板上接出这段脚本写的证明。
inverse.to: Wire on the proof board the proof this script writes.

inverse.from: 有了「下雨」和「刮风」，要「下雨 ∧ 刮风」。
inverse.to: With “it rains” and “it is windy”, “it rains ∧ it is windy” is wanted.

inverse.from: 这段脚本每一句后面的 by 还空着。选出每一句用的规则。
inverse.to: Each row’s by is still empty in this script. Choose the rule each row uses.

inverse.from: 读
inverse.to: Read

inverse.from: 块里还可以套块。
inverse.to: A block can hold another block.

inverse.from: 块套着块
inverse.to: Blocks in blocks

inverse.from: b 给不给自己刮？
inverse.to: Does b shave himself?

inverse.from: 假设有这么一个人，把他拿出来，叫他 b。
inverse.to: Suppose there is such a person; take him out and call him b.

inverse.from: 「有一个人，给且只给不给自己刮胡子的人刮胡子。」写一段脚本，证明没有这样的人。
inverse.to: “There is someone who shaves exactly those who do not shave themselves.” Write a script that proves there is no such person.

inverse.from: 证明器从两个元件长到这里，没有一步是核不认的。
inverse.to: The prover grew from two parts to this, and not one step was one the kernel would not take.

inverse.from: 最后一段脚本，用上这台证明器的每一层。
inverse.to: A last script, using every layer of this prover.

inverse.from: 毕业：理发师
inverse.to: Graduation: the barber

inverse.from: 一对，两边各算一次。
inverse.to: A pair, each side worked out once.

inverse.from: p 和 q 都假的那一行呢？
inverse.to: What of the row where p and q are both false?

inverse.from: 先点检查，看核把 taut 算成了什么。
inverse.to: Check first and see what the kernel works taut out to.

inverse.from: 已知 complete 说：taut x 算出假，x 就不是永远成立。
inverse.to: The given complete says: if taut x works out false, x does not always hold.

inverse.from: 算出来是假
inverse.to: It works out false

inverse.from: 这一关的定义都给化简用上。
inverse.to: Give Simp every definition of this level.

inverse.from: 设计一个证明助手：每个目标都证出来。
inverse.to: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.

inverse.from: <level-ref to="au-cert"></level-ref>里，外面的证明器交来证书，核照着重放。另一条路不要证书，靠核按定义去算。公式也能写成数据：Or p (Not p) 是一样东西；eval f a b 按定义算出它在 p 取 a、q 取 b 那一行的真假；taut f 把四行都算一遍。这样的程序叫<wiki-ref to="decision"></wiki-ref>，它判定一句话是不是永远成立。
inverse.to: In <level-ref to="au-cert"></level-ref> an outside prover handed over a certificate and the kernel replayed it. The other way needs no certificate and relies on the kernel computing by the definitions. A formula can be data too: Or p (Not p) is a thing; eval f a b works out by the definitions whether it is true on the row where p is a and q is b; taut f works out all four rows. Such a program is a <wiki-ref to="decision"></wiki-ref>: it decides whether a sentence always holds.

inverse.from: 还是一样的证明项。
inverse.to: The same proof term again.

inverse.from: 和第一题一样，x 从要证的那句里读出来。
inverse.to: As in the first, x is read off the sentence to prove.

inverse.from: sound 要一个 taut x = 真 的证明。核会按定义算。
inverse.to: sound wants a proof of taut x = true, and the kernel computes by the definitions.

inverse.from: 这条路叫<wiki-ref to="reflection"></wiki-ref>，Lean 的 decide 就是这样做的。
inverse.to: This way is called <wiki-ref to="reflection"></wiki-ref>, and it is how Lean’s decide works.

inverse.from: 已知 sound 说判定程序是对的：taut x 算出真，x 就永远成立。它只要对所有公式证一次（对公式归纳）。
inverse.to: The given sound says the decision procedure is right: if taut x works out true, x always holds. It needs proving only once, for every formula (by induction on formulas).

inverse.from: 让核来算
inverse.to: Let the kernel compute

inverse.from: 五层 fun：三样东西，两个等式。
inverse.to: Five funs: three things and two equations.

inverse.from: q 倒着也一样用：核两边都试。
inverse.to: q works the other way round too: the kernel tries both sides.

inverse.from: 用一个等式把要证的那句换一换，换出来的应当正是另一个已知。
inverse.to: Use one equation to change the sentence to prove; what comes out should be the other given.

inverse.from: 自反、对称、传递，写成证明项都只用 rfl 和 ▸。
inverse.to: Reflexive, symmetric, transitive: as terms, all three use only rfl and ▸.

inverse.from: <level-ref to="q-trans"></level-ref>把两个等式连成了一个。写成证明项。
inverse.to: <level-ref to="q-trans"></level-ref> joined two equations into one. Write it as a term.

inverse.from: 一路相等的证明项
inverse.to: The term of equal all along

inverse.from: 要证的那句里，晨星出现了两处。
inverse.to: The Morning Star appears twice in the sentence to prove.

inverse.from: 三层 fun：两样东西 a、b，和一个 a = b 的证明 h。
inverse.to: Three funs: two things a and b, and a proof h of a = b.

inverse.from: <level-ref to="q-sym"></level-ref>里用了<part-ref to="part:refl"></part-ref>和<part-ref to="part:rewrite"></part-ref>，各写成什么？
inverse.to: <level-ref to="q-sym"></level-ref> used <part-ref to="part:refl"></part-ref> and <part-ref to="part:rewrite"></part-ref>; how is each written?

inverse.from: <level-ref to="q-sym"></level-ref>在证明板上把等式倒了过来。写成证明项。
inverse.to: <level-ref to="q-sym"></level-ref> turned an equation round on the proof board. Write it as a term.

inverse.from: 倒过来的证明项
inverse.to: The term of turning round

inverse.from: 要证的等式两边都是晨星，用不着已知。
inverse.to: Both sides of the equation are the Morning Star; the given is not needed.

inverse.from: <part-ref to="part:allI"></part-ref>是 fun：拿到 a，要证的是 a = a。
inverse.to: <part-ref to="part:allI"></part-ref> is a fun: given a, what is left is a = a.

inverse.from: 新块 rfl 证的是两边一样的等式。
inverse.to: The new piece rfl proves an equation whose two sides are alike.

inverse.from: 造等式的路只有一条：rfl，证两边一样的等式，比如 a = a。它就是证明板上的。
inverse.to: There is one way to make an equation: rfl, which proves an equation whose two sides are alike, such as a = a. It is on the proof board.

inverse.from: 化简器拿等式当改写规则，数与列表一章也证过不少等式。在 Lean 里，a = b 也是一个类型，它的证明项同样由核检查。
inverse.to: The simplifier used equations as rewrite rules, and the chapter on numbers and lists proved many. In Lean, a = b is a type too, and its proof terms are checked by the kernel like any other.

inverse.from: 两边一样
inverse.to: Both sides alike

inverse.from: 先由 q 换出「昏星很亮」，再交给 r。
inverse.to: First turn q into “the Evening Star is bright”, then give it to r.

inverse.from: 这回 q 说的是昏星，要证的是晨星：核两个方向都会试。
inverse.to: This time q is about the Evening Star and the goal about the Morning Star: the kernel tries both ways.

inverse.from: 「□ ▸ □」：前一个框放等式，后一个框放关于晨星的那句。
inverse.to: “□ ▸ □”: the equation in the first box, the sentence about the Morning Star in the second.

inverse.from: 用<part-ref to="part:rewrite"></part-ref>。
inverse.to: Use <part-ref to="part:rewrite"></part-ref>.

inverse.from: 已知 p：「晨星 = 昏星」、q：「晨星很亮」，证出「昏星很亮」，再看它的证明项。
inverse.to: Given p: “the Morning Star = the Evening Star” and q: “the Morning Star is bright”, prove “the Evening Star is bright”, then look at its term.

inverse.from: 接线
inverse.to: Wire

inverse.from: 它就是证明板上的<part-ref to="part:rewrite"></part-ref>：先接一个，看它写出的证明项，再到证明项板上自己写。
inverse.to: It is <part-ref to="part:rewrite"></part-ref> on the proof board: wire one first and see the term it writes, then write it yourself on the term board.

inverse.from: 用等式只有一条路：h ▸ p（Lean 里是 Eq.rec）。h 证 a = b，p 证关于 a 的一句话，h ▸ p 证关于 b 的那一句。换掉哪几处，由说明。
inverse.to: There is one way to use an equation: h ▸ p (Eq.rec in Lean). If h proves a = b and p proves a sentence about a, h ▸ p proves the same sentence about b. Which places are replaced is given by the .

inverse.from: 证明板上点的框，就是证明项里没写出来的那部分：要证的那句里，哪几处是从等式一边换过来的，叫动机；核从要证的那句和后一个框的类型里把它读出来
inverse.to: the boxes ticked on the proof board are the part a term does not write out: which places of the sentence to prove came from one side of the equation, the motive; the kernel reads it off the sentence to prove and the type of the second box

inverse.from: 等量代换的证明项
inverse.to: The term of rewriting

inverse.from: 外层的 0 + 算得掉，里层的 + 0 算不掉。
inverse.to: The outer 0 + works out, the inner + 0 does not.

inverse.from: addZero 用在 m 上，得到 m + 0 = m。
inverse.to: addZero used on m gives m + 0 = m.

inverse.from: 先试 fun a => rfl，看核怎么说。
inverse.to: Try fun a => rfl first and see what the kernel says.

inverse.from: 对的、核却算不出来、要靠证明的相等，叫<wiki-ref to="propeq"></wiki-ref>。
inverse.to: An equality that is true but that the kernel cannot work out, so that it takes a proof, is a <wiki-ref to="propeq"></wiki-ref>.

inverse.from: 定义只说 0 和 S x 加上 y 是什么；x 是不知道的数时，x + 0 就算不下去。<level-ref to="in-zero"></level-ref>用归纳证出了 x + 0 = x，这一关里它是已知 addZero，用法和别的「对所有」一样：addZero m 证 m + 0 = m。
inverse.to: The definition only says what 0 and S x plus y are; when x is an unknown number, x + 0 does not work out. <level-ref to="in-zero"></level-ref> proved x + 0 = x by induction, and here it is the given addZero, used like any “for all”: addZero m proves m + 0 = m.

inverse.from: 要证明的相等
inverse.to: Equal by proof

inverse.from: 第二种换法要一个倒过来的等式。
inverse.to: The second wants the equation turned round.

inverse.from: 一处要把晨星换成昏星，另一处要把昏星换成晨星。

Isabelle 的 Isar（Wenzel，1999 年起）把证明写成给人读的文本，叫结构化证明：have 先证一句，show 证出要证的那句，assume、fix、obtain 开出假设、任取的东西和拿出来的东西，proof … qed 是一块。每一句后面 by 的那个方法只负责一小步，系统检查每一句。Lean 的写法相近：have h : A := by …，show B，intro，obtain ⟨x, h⟩ := …，再加上把一串等式连起来的 calc。
脚本和证明项、证明电路是同一个证明：每一行是一个元件，块是框。大型的形式化（四色定理、开普勒猜想、数学库 mathlib 和 AFP）都是这样写成的：人写结构和引理，自动化补中间的小步。
类型里的长度算不出一样时，要用一个等式把值搬运过去：h ▸ v 是同一个向量，换上一个相等的长度。这是的代价；Lean 的库里常常为此把定义换一种写法，让需要的相等变成定义相等。

这个游戏的向量只记长度，所以 Vec n 当作一句话，它的证明就是一个向量。Lean 里两者是分开的：Prop 里的证明只关心有没有，两个证明算同一个（证明无关性）；Type 里的值（数、列表、向量）才是程序算的东西。
x + 0 = x 是对的，但加法按第一个数递归，x 不知道是几，核算不下去：它要用归纳证，这叫命题相等。用它换掉类型里的一处要写 ▸；不用写，核自己会算。Isabelle 的 HOL 没有定义相等这一层，所有相等都由规则证出，或者由化简器算出。
核比较两个类型前，会按定义去算（展开定义、代入参数、β 归约），算出来一样的就算一样，这叫定义相等：1 + 1 = 2、0 + x = x 用 rfl 就证完，一个证明的类型也可以按它来换。哪些相等是定义相等，取决于定义是怎么写的。
在 Lean 里，a = b 也是一个类型。造它只有 rfl（a = a），用它只有 Eq.rec，写作 h ▸ p：h 证 a = b，p 证一句关于 a 的话，就得到把其中几处 a 换成 b 的那句。换哪几处，由一个函数 fun x => … 说清，这个函数叫动机；Lean 多半能从要证的那句里把它读出来。对称、传递都由这两样拼出：h ▸ rfl、k ▸ h。
吃一对的函数和一个一个吃的函数可以互相改写：A ∧ B → C 和 A → (B → C) 互相推得出。把前者换成后者叫柯里化，得名于 Haskell Curry。证明助手里多参数的函数和多前提的规则，都写成一个一个吃的样子。
「∀x. P(x)」的证明是一个函数，参数不是证明，而是一样东西：给它 t，它还你 P(t) 的证明。结果的类型跟着参数变，所以叫依赖函数，它的类型写作 Π x, P x，Lean 里就写 ∀ x, P x。∃ 对应的是依赖的一对（Σ 类型）：一样东西，和它满足那句话的证明。
把证明项里的弯路（刚引入就消去）一处处拿掉，直到一处都不剩，得到的是正规形式。直觉主义逻辑的每个证明项都化得成正规形式，而且不管先拿哪一处，结果都一样（强正规化、合流）。正规的证明只用到要证的那句里出现过的东西，这是 Gentzen 和 Prawitz 证明论的出发点。
(fun h => b) a 算成「b 里的 h 换成 a」，这一步叫 β 归约，就是调用一个函数。证明里，一个刚造出来就被套用，是一处弯路；β 归约把它拿掉，证的还是同一句。
fun h => b（也写成 λ h => b）造一个函数：拿到一个 h，就给出 b。这叫 λ 抽象，是 Church 在 1930 年代的 λ 演算里的写法。假设框就是 λ：框里的假设是参数 h，框里的证明是函数体 b，框外得到 A → B 的证明。
把一个证明写成一个式子，就是它的证明项：已知是名字，套用是 p q，假设框是 fun h => …，拼起来是 ⟨a, b⟩。按，它同时是一个程序，类型就是它证的那句话。证明项留下来，谁都可以拿另一个检查器复查。
Curry–Howard 对应：一句话就是一个类型，它的证明就是这个类型的一个程序（项）。「A → B」的证明是函数，「A ∧ B」的证明是一对，「A ∨ B」的证明是带标签的值，⊥ 是没有任何值的空类型，「¬A」就是「A → ⊥」；「∀x. …」的证明是吃一样东西的函数，「∃x. …」的证明是一样东西和关于它的证明配成的一对。
证明板上的规则也一一对上：套用是函数应用，假设框是 λ，拼起来和拆开是造一对和取分量，分情况是按标签分支。所以检查证明就是检查类型。
反证法没有对应的程序：没有哪个程序能从「A 不会不成立」变出 A 的证明。所以直觉主义逻辑正好是程序能做到的那部分，经典逻辑要把反证法或排中律另外当公理加上。
反射不留证书：把要判定的句子写成数据，写一个，证明一次它是对的，以后每一题只要核把程序算出来，证明项就是 rfl。Lean 的 decide、Coq 的 ssreflect 走的是这条路。算得快慢看核怎么算，所以也有判定过程（比如 Lean 的 omega）是生成证明交给核去查。
对一类问题里的每一个都能停下来、答对「是」还是「不是」的程序，叫判定程序。命题逻辑的永真式可以判定（把真值表算完）；线性算术、Presburger 算术也有判定程序。一阶逻辑整体没有。
